## Source growth program

### New candidates discovered today

Six Chinese commercial-platform candidates were added to today's discovery/audit ledger: 17K小说网, 七猫中文网, 潇湘书院, 红袖读书, SF轻小说/菠萝包轻小说, and 刺猬猫. This exceeds the daily minimum of five discovered candidates.

### Full audits

**17K小说网 — PASS for link-only discovery; richer adapter deferred.** The current service agreement identifies 中文在线 as the service operator, covers the website and client, and reserves ungranted rights; current public pages expose first-party discovery while the rights notice states that site content may not be reproduced without permission. HTTPS and a stable first-party home are available. Because the admitted WebNR source only opens the official landing page, CORS, cookies, login, pagination, request cadence, rate limits, encoding, response size, and chapter failure semantics are outside the admitted runtime boundary. Any richer adapter remains blocked on a separate reproducible robots/interface/rights/paging/cadence/update audit with versioned fixtures.

**七猫中文网 — PASS for link-only discovery; richer adapter deferred.** The current 七猫作家助手 service agreement identifies 上海七猫文化传媒有限公司 and affiliates, explicitly names `qimao.com` among its literature platforms, reserves ungranted software/platform rights, and prohibits unauthorized third-party software/data interaction. The official platform provides a stable HTTPS discovery destination. WebNR therefore admits only the first-party link and its own metadata. Search/result extraction, ranking polling, chapter retrieval, accounts, advertising flows, creator works, and platform data are excluded. A richer adapter requires explicit machine-interface permission plus robots, cadence, pagination, timeout, provenance, deletion/update, and work-rights fixtures.

**SF轻小说 / 菠萝包轻小说 — DEFER.** The current public novel list exposes useful category, completion-state, update-window, author, word-count, and pagination fields, which gives strong reader-discovery value. Current platform material also exposes membership/payment behavior and work-level copyright/VIP boundaries. Those rights and access signals make a link-only future directory candidate plausible, while automated catalog/chapter ingestion requires a separate first-party service/robots/interface permission audit, bounded paging/cadence behavior, and fixtures. No WebNR source was admitted today.
